svg.aria-label: Cumulative regret of six bandit algorithms on a 10-armed Bernoulli bandit, averaged over 200 runs of 50,000 pulls. Left, against t on a linear axis: greedy and epsilon-greedy with epsilon 0.1 grow linearly, reaching about 2,000 and 1,700. Right, against log t: UCB1, epsilon 0.01 and the gradient bandit bend into roughly straight lines, Thompson sampling stays lowest at about 68, below the dashed Lai-Robbins asymptotic lower bound of 10.1 log t, which only binds as t grows
svg.text: linear time: greedy and ε = 0.1 grow linearly
log scale of t: log T regret becomes a straight line
